description: Pitch analysis of the first print test video: played notes against the model and against C21, C22

extractions.what: At a soft breath both played notes sit within about 15 cents of the modelled passive resonances (340.1 and 469.8 Hz); a harder breath raises them by up to about 120 cents (open) and 200 cents (closed), an effect of the jet the model leaves out
Played interval at one breath strength about 600 cents (503 / 356 Hz), against 560 cents in the model
